meta.title: Sport Science Day at the Museum

paragraphs: Sport Science Day at the Science Museum! Mia copied this advertisement from the board at the museum. She posted it on Explorers' Blog, because it is very exciting. Do you like sport and science? Then come to the museum on Saturday. Teacher Kim says that all the Explorers can go together. The museum is in our town, and it is easy to find.

The topic of the day is speed. The day is on Saturday, from ten o'clock to three o'clock. There are three big experiments, and each one has a different guide. Small groups of ten children go together, so nobody waits for long. Each experiment takes about forty minutes. Guide Ann leads the first one. Come to the main door, and ask for a green card.

Experiment One is about a rugby ball. A rugby ball is not round, so it bounces in a strange way. You throw the ball, and you guess where it will go. Do not worry if you cannot guess, because it is very hard. Then Guide Ann shows you why it goes there. Guide Ann answers your questions after each test. It is the funniest experiment of the day!

Experiment Two is about cycling. The museum has a special track behind the building, and it is one mile long. You ride a bike on the track, and a big clock shows your time. The clock starts when you leave the green line. Helmets are free, and an assistant checks every bike. Most children ride the mile in about eight minutes. Will you ride faster than your friends?

Experiment Three is about running. You run for ten seconds, and a machine measures your speed. The machine is a long white box with a small screen. A cheetah runs faster than any other animal on land. Every child gets a free copy of the Speed Book. The book has pictures, facts, and a game. It is the best book for a young scientist!

The price is twenty baht for each child. A parent can come for free. Wear sports shoes, and bring a bottle of water. Bring a notebook, and write down your results. Please come early, because many families visit on Saturday. Do you have a question? Contact Guide Ann by email. We think this is the best Saturday plan!
